Resolves #21708

Related: #21704, #21705, #21761

Mounts `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher` across all 17 remaining published non-`ConfigurationViewport` standalone examples in `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` outside #21706 and #21707 (plus 3 multi-window companion/child apps): `form/validation`, `component/{sparkline,markdown,toast,graphScene,gallery,helix,coronaGallery,coronaHelix,multiWindowCoronaGallery,multiWindowHelix}`, `component/wrapper/{mermaid,openStreetMaps}`, `charts`, `videoMove`, and `stateProvider/{advanced,multiWindow}` (alongside the 4 existing verified switchers in `calendar/basic`, `code/livePreview`, `component/video`, and `dialog`). Upgrades single-theme and implicit-default `neo-config.json` files to coherent light/dark pairs, synchronizes theme changes across SharedWorker companion windows, and removes hardcoded `#2b2b2b`/`#ddd` dark-only panel styles on the 3D gallery/helix controls so light mode renders legibly (leaving centralized `?theme=` / start-theme boot resolution to #21761).

Evidence: L3 (local Playwright Chromium Whitebox E2E + 34-cell rendered audit + whole-page visual pairs at `1440 × 900` and `390 × 844`) → L3 required (AC-1..AC-3).

|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered + census-verified: all 21 published non-`ConfigurationViewport` standalone examples in #21708's catalog groups expose an interactive switcher (`17` wired to `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher` + `3` multi-window companion/child apps, plus `4` pre-existing verified switchers); `test/playwright/e2e/component/StandaloneThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs` (registered in `test/playwright/externalBrainSelection.mjs` and `buildScripts/util/e2eCiSelection.mjs`, `288/304` engine-tier specs) exercises live App Worker + DOM theme toggling, Mermaid diagram redraw, and cross-window propagation. |

| AC-3 | CI-covered: `e2e (engine)` runs `component/StandaloneThemeSwitcher.spec.mjs`, `form/ValidationExample.spec.mjs`, `portal/HighlightJsResources.spec.mjs`, `core/SharedStateMultiWindow.spec.mjs`, `code/LivePreviewExample.spec.mjs`, `rendering/GraphScene.spec.mjs`, and `rendering/MarkdownStreamingCoherenceNL.spec.mjs` (`22/22` passed locally). |

## Deltas from ticket
- Upgraded `examples/component/markdown/neo-config.json` (which previously omitted `"themes"`, falling back to `DefaultConfig.mjs`'s 3-theme list without `neo-theme-neo-dark` or `component/Markdown.css`) to `["neo-theme-neo-light", "neo-theme-neo-dark"]`.
- Preserved `["neo-theme-light", "neo-theme-dark"]` on `examples/component/toast` so `.hljs` retains its `6px` (`0.5em` at `12px`) padding asserted by `portal/HighlightJsResources.spec.mjs`, and fixed `.neo-examples-toast-body.neo-flex-direction-row` specificity at `@media (max-width: 700px)` so `.output` stacks full-width on mobile instead of clipping horizontally.
- Replaced `examples/component/wrapper/mermaid`'s bespoke `SwitchField` + `onDarkChange` handler with `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher` (`ui: 'secondary'`), keeping `Mermaid`'s `observeConfig` redraw intact.
- Left all 19 touched examples' `app.mjs` files in their `dev` form rather than adding per-app `URLSearchParams` `?theme=` boot copies, leaving centralized start-theme resolution to #21761.

## Cold look
Two independent readers without session context graded 5 unlabelled `origin/dev` (`M`) vs branch (`N`) whole-page pairs in swapped order (`M→N` and `N→M`) — **10/10 verdicts `BETTER: N`**:
- **`form/validation` (`1440 × 900`):** `M→N` `5.5` → `6.0` (`BETTER: N`); `N→M` `6` vs `4` (`BETTER: N`) — `N` aligns the form fields vertically with the header/footer (`padding: 0` on `.signup-form`) and adds a bordered `[Neo Dark]` button without squeezing the 3-line subtitle.
- **`component/toast` (`1440 × 900`):** `M→N` `6.0` → `7.5` (`BETTER: N`); `N→M` `8` vs `5` (`BETTER: N`) — `N` frames the split view with a `Toast Builder` + `[DARK]` top toolbar and divider.
- **`component/toast` (`390 × 844`):** `M→N` `3.0` → `7.0` (`BETTER: N`); `N→M` `7` vs `2` (`BETTER: N`) — `M` crushed `.output` into an unreadable ~90px strip (`Ne` / `})`), whereas `N` stacks controls above a full-width code preview with a compact icon-only switcher.
- **`charts` (`1440 × 900`):** `M→N` `7.5` → `8.0` (`BETTER: N`); `N→M` `9` vs `7` (`BETTER: N`) — `N` adds `amCharts Pie` + `[Neo Dark]` while preserving `50px` chart/legend margins and watermark clearance.
- **`component/wrapper/mermaid` (`1440 × 900`):** `M→N` `7.0` → `7.5` (`BETTER: N`); `N→M` `8` vs `7` (`BETTER: N`) — `N` replaces the low-contrast `SwitchField` with a bordered `[Neo Dark]` button matching the 4 preset buttons.

Frame critique: Pre-existing outside-#21708 traits noted by the cold-look readers and left untouched to preserve existing example contracts/specs: in `form/validation`, `CheckBox` defaults to `labelPosition: 'left'` (wrapping `"I agree to the terms and conditions"` with the box on the right), disabled `Sign up` uses theme-default muted gray, `"type."` wraps onto line 2 of the hint, and `.signup-card`'s `--panel-background-color` matches the white page surface in `neo-theme-neo-light`; in `component/toast`, legacy `itemDefaults` keep `width: 200` + `marginLeft: '10px'` (leaving right whitespace at `390 × 844`), `key = value` inline labels, right-placed `Closable` checkbox, and HighlightJS's gutter right border; in `charts`, top-left small-slice callouts sit close and legend row 2 left-aligns 2 items per amCharts 4 layout; in `mermaid`, preset buttons carry no active-tab state, `<textarea>` has compact padding, and pane bottom borders differ by ~4px. Earlier cold-look Round-1 findings (subtitle squeeze + `20px` `.signup-form` offset in `form/validation`, `16px` padding watermark collision in `charts`, and ghost button styling in `mermaid`) were all fixed prior to final capture (`5ab7772524`).
